_doc: Tier-3 OOS: real venture (Vanta) — automated security compliance / GRC platform. Raised $150M Series B (Sequoia, 2023) at $2.45B valuation. Strict OOS — venture and case constructed from public press only.
_oos_provenance: Vanta Series B announcement Sequoia 2023; G2 reviews; Vanta blog public claims; Drata/Secureframe public funding rounds for analog comps

venture_under_test.name: Vanta
venture_under_test.description: Vanta is a B2B SaaS automated security compliance platform helping companies achieve and maintain SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI compliance through continuous monitoring of their cloud infrastructure and processes. Target customers: Series A through pre-IPO B2B SaaS companies with 20-2000 employees pursuing enterprise sales that require compliance certifications. Pricing: $7,500-$50,000/year tiered by company size and number of frameworks. Target buyer: Head of Security, Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), or VP of Engineering at startups without a dedicated compliance team. Competes with Drata, Secureframe, Tugboat Logic, Hyperproof, and OneTrust. Differentiation: deepest pre-built control library (1,000+ controls vs competitors' 200-500), native auditor partnership network reduces audit cycle time 50%, and bundled vendor security review automation.
venture_under_test.category: B2B SaaS automated security compliance / GRC
